PostToolUse.statusMessage: Checking if README.md needs an update...
PostToolUse.command: INPUT=$(cat); TOOL=$(printf '%s' "$INPUT" | jq -r '.tool_name // empty'); case "$TOOL" in create_file|replace_string_in_file|multi_replace_string_in_file) ;; *) echo '{}'; exit 0;; esac; PATHS=$(printf '%s' "$INPUT" | jq -r '[.. | .filePath? // empty] | map(select(length > 0)) | join("\n")' 2>/dev/null); MATCH=$(printf '%s' "$PATHS" | grep -E 'package\.json$|astro\.config|/docs/|src/pages/|schemaTypes/'); if [ -z "$MATCH" ]; then echo '{}'; exit 0; fi; CTX="Files just changed that README.md may describe: $(printf '%s' "$MATCH" | tr '\n' ',' ). Check whether README.md (tech stack, scripts, structure, or docs links) needs a corresponding update."; jq -n --arg ctx "$CTX" '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PostToolUse","additionalContext":$ctx}}'
